institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Degradation of fresh and natural flavors in ripe jackfruit over time.
description: A process where ripe jackfruit is dehydrated to an optimum moisture level and water activity using novel drying methods, and then preserved in honey. The product is packaged in standalone polyethylene bags.
applications: • Manufacturing of commercial honey-preserved fruit snacks • Production of premium shelf-stable tropical fruit preserves • Processing of preservative-free natural sweet confections • Formulation of value-added agricultural export products
